<div class="cna-page">
<p class="cna-kicker">Conference · May 24–25, 2024 · Chicago</p>
<p class="cna-evloc">BMO Institute for Health Equity, RUSH University, Chicago, USA</p>
<div class="cna-evhero"><img src="../assets/events/166576_0.jpg" alt="3rd International Conference on Current Issues in Coincidence Analysis"></div>

<div class="cna-evtwo">
<div class="cna-evmain">
<div class="cna-evdesc">
<p class="cna-evtag">The third international conference dedicated exclusively to the configurational comparative method of Coincidence Analysis (CNA).</p>
<p>The third edition of this international conference on Coincidence Analysis provides a platform for exchange between CNA methodologists and applied researchers. The newest methodological developments and open questions will be presented alongside exemplary applications from an open range of disciplines.</p>
</div>
<h2>Confirmed speakers</h2>
<ul class="cna-speakers">
<li>Deborah Cragun / Nina Sperber (Univ. of South Florida / Duke University): The value of contrapositive consistency and coverage in selecting among causal chain models explaining the adoption of pharmacogenetic testing for antidepressants</li>
<li>Pavel Svačina / Jonathan Freitas (VSE Prague / Univ. of Minas Gerais): Do transaction costs or transactional value matter in technology licensing? Lessons learned from configurational causal modelling</li>
<li>Jessica Dodge (VA Pittsburgh): Difference making implementation strategies for significant implementation: Coincidence Analysis on a global systematic review of implementation studies</li>
<li>Jonathan Freitas (Univ. of Minas Gerais): Developing an online/hybrid course on CNA</li>
<li>Yinfei Duan (University of Alberta): Process and context factors contributing to or impeding successful implementation of a complex team-based behavioral intervention: a configurational analysis of the INFORM trial data</li>
<li>Dennis H. Li / Alithia Zamantakis / Reiping Huang (Northwestern University): Contextual factors predicting reach of a digital HIV intervention delivered by community-based organizations across the US</li>
<li>Luna De Souter / Michael Baumgartner (Univ. of Bergen): Evaluating sufficiency and necessity in model building with Coincidence Analysis</li>
<li>Martyna Swiatczak (Univ. of Bergen): A Comparative Configurational Analysis on the Introduction of Statutory Minimum Wage</li>
<li>Meghan Lane-Fall / Sapna Mendon-Plasek (University of Pennsylvania / RAND): Systematic review of the use of Configurational Comparative Methods (including QCA and CNA) in the field of implementation science</li>
</ul>
<p><a href="https://www.uib.no/sites/www.uib.no/files/attachments/program_36.pdf">Tentative program</a> · <a href="https://www.uib.no/sites/w3.uib.no/files/attachments/cfp_cna24.pdf">Call for papers</a>.</p>
</div>
